scripts.build: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm build:tailwind && vite build
scripts.build:fixtures: pnpm build && pnpm --filter neobrui-cube-css-modules build && pnpm --filter neobrui-cube-astro build && pnpm --filter neobrui-cube-tailwind build
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm validate:tokens && playwright test
scripts.verify: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build:fixtures && pnpm test
scripts.build:docs: pnpm release:local && pnpm --dir apps/docs install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --config.strict-dep-builds=false && pnpm --dir apps/docs rebuild esbuild && pnpm --dir apps/docs build
scripts.preview:docs: pnpm run build:docs && pnpm --dir apps/docs preview
scripts.preview:docs:pages: pnpm run build:docs:pages && pnpm --dir apps/docs preview:pages
